# web.dev
> Guidance to build modern web experiences that work on any browser.

web.dev is Google's developer resource for modern web development, with practical guidance, structured courses, reference-style topic hubs, patterns, and tooling focused on performance, accessibility, identity, and core web technologies.

## Core Topics
- [HTML](https://web.dev/html): Topic hub for HTML fundamentals, semantics, forms, and document structure.
- [CSS](https://web.dev/css): Topic hub for styling, layout, responsive design, and modern CSS features.
- [JavaScript](https://web.dev/javascript): Topic hub for JavaScript language features, APIs, and application patterns.
- [Performance](https://web.dev/performance): Topic hub for Core Web Vitals, loading, rendering, and runtime optimization.
- [Accessibility](https://web.dev/accessibility): Topic hub for inclusive design, semantics, keyboard support, and assistive technology.
- [Identity](https://web.dev/identity): Topic hub for authentication, passkeys, WebAuthn, and identity flows on the web.

## Learn Courses
- [Learn web development](https://web.dev/learn): Course index for structured learning paths across core web technologies.
- [Learn HTML](https://web.dev/learn/html): Full HTML course covering elements, semantics, forms, and document authoring.
- [Learn CSS](https://web.dev/learn/css): Full CSS course covering selectors, layout, responsive design, and advanced styling.
- [Learn JavaScript](https://web.dev/learn/javascript): Full JavaScript course covering syntax, logic, objects, and browser programming.
- [Learn Performance](https://web.dev/learn/performance): Course on measuring and improving loading, rendering, and interaction performance.
- [Learn Accessibility](https://web.dev/learn/accessibility): Course on building usable interfaces for people with diverse abilities.
- [Learn AI](https://web.dev/learn/ai): Course on integrating AI capabilities and workflows into web experiences.

## Explore
- [Explore](https://web.dev/explore): Discovery hub for articles, collections, and topic-based web development guidance.
- [AI and the web](https://web.dev/explore/ai): Collection focused on AI capabilities, browser integration, and web developer workflows.

## Patterns and Examples
- [Patterns](https://web.dev/patterns): Reusable UI and UX patterns with implementation guidance and code examples.

## Tools
- [PageSpeed Insights](https://pagespeed.web.dev/): Performance analysis tool for lab and field data on web pages.

## Media and Updates
- [Podcasts & shows](https://web.dev/shows): Video and audio programming covering web platform news and developer education.
- [Developer Newsletter](https://web.dev/newsletter): Email updates featuring new articles, courses, and web platform guidance.

## About
- [About web.dev](https://web.dev/about): Overview of the site, its mission, and the team behind it.
